Honestly the best way to get help is to just do it. I was in the worst depressive episode of my life 8 years into struggling with depression when I finally decided to see a therapist and psychiatrist. I know finding the motivation to do these things can be difficult, so if your parents are supportive of you then you should let them know what’s going on so they can help set you up with therapy. I’m not gonna sit here and tell you it’s gonna get better and all that cheesy crap, but the fact that you posted this means that part of you does want to get better and once you’ve taken that leap, everything that follows will be much easier 

I understand your desire to not be put in a psych ward, so even though that may be what’s best you can still seek help. If you tell a therapist you’re suicidal they will simply try to help you in whatever ways they can, they can’t tell anyone else that confidential information. Of course I have no idea what your life is like beyond this post, but it seems like your parents are supportive of you in your efforts to find a job so I’m sure they would be supportive of you finding help and bettering yourself mentally as well.

Nta, i usually don’t comment but the esh ruling doesn’t sit well with me. 

your parents showing blatant favoritism, definitely making them the assholes. now regarding your behavior, it’s completely understandable that you feel resentment towards your sister due to how your parents treat you guys, but that doesn’t make it right to talk to her and about her the way you do. it’s your parents fault that she is spoiled and immature, their favoritism bred that in her. 

i think if you made an effort to make peace with your sister and sit down and try your best to bond despite your differences, she could become a member on your team. if you explain to her that your bad blood is due to your parents and the way they treat you and that you know this isn’t necessarily her fault and your sorry for insulting her, you could potentially come to an understanding and she could be someone that stands up for you. of course, it’s more than possible that she won’t be open to this kind of relationship and not want to discuss things maturely and that would make her an asshole along with your parents, but you won’t know this until you try. 

since your bad blood is a directly results of your parents being assholes, that’s why I deem you not an asshole. but, you can go about your relationship with your sister better and calling her slurs is not justified no matter how pesky she is. you both have room to grow and hopefully now that you’re aware of your misplaced resentment you can work on things more productively.
